purpose: Teach: 雅子/恵子/静香/直人/健一/和夫/篤/哉

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「雅子様の御活動は希望」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying that Masako has such a hopeful spirit about her work.
lines.style: Warm, sharing something she learned. Gentle pace, like passing along a small gift of information. Voice settled and thoughtful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと恵子おばさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to visit Dad and Aunt Keiko.
lines.style: Bright and direct, eager to share. Quick opening, speech tumbling forward without hesitation. The small-voiced pride of having done something grown-up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「静香さんは芸術家肌」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad mentioned that Shizuka has such an artistic sensibility.
lines.style: Same warmth as before, but a beat more measured. Still sharing, still gentle, but the voice settles into listening mode after the statement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと直人さんの子供達と遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I played with Dad and Naoto's kids.
lines.style: Straightforward and pleased. Light energy, matter-of-fact delivery. The simple satisfaction of a small adventure told without embellishment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「健一さんは古い友達」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was telling me that Kenichi is an old friend of his.
lines.style: Warm but quieter now. Thoughtful pause before the statement, as if Mei is remembering something Dad said with affection. Voice carries the weight of family history.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに和夫おじさんの結婚式の話を聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I heard Dad talking about Uncle Kazuo's wedding.
lines.style: Earnest and attentive. Slower pace than before, more grounded. Sho's voice carries the sense that this story mattered, that he was listening carefully to what Dad shared.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「篤いお気持ちを大事にね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said it's important to treasure deep and sincere feelings.
lines.style: Warmth with intention. Voice gentle but clear, like Mei is imparting something that matters. She leans slightly into the words, making sure Sho hears the care in them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「逝去哉、つまり古文の感嘆」を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me about the classical Japanese particle 'ya' — how it expresses wonder and awe.
lines.style: Earnest and grounded. Sho's voice is steady, pleased with what he's learned. Speaking as if reporting something he's proud to have understood. Warm closure to the moment.
